english.title: Public assembly participant fail to comply with condition
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 14(5) and (9) of the Public Order Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
took part in public assembly and failed to comply with
condition imposed by senior police officer and at the time he/she failed to comply
knew/ought to have known
the condition was imposed

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence applies from the 28th June 2022 due to changes made by the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022 increasing the penalty. For the offence applying before this date, see H2442.
(ii) The prosecution are required to prove that the participant knew or ought to have known a condition was imposed.
(iii) Section 14(5) provides a defence where the failure arose from circumstances beyond the defendant's control.
